added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

durability.reason: read-only measurement whose report and phase tables are under the run directory; the harness copy left on node-local /tmp is a provenance gap recorded in the plan followup that carries its three proposed fixes, and the outlier attribution is marked as inferred there

findings.text: the report states the harness (driver.py + setup_fixture.py) was 'kept outside the run dir; copies deposited as artifacts below', but no driver.py or setup_fixture.py exists anywhere in the run directory, and the manifest's artifacts list names neither; the only copy is /tmp/sdp/harness, node-local scratch that dies with the allocation, so the instrument that produced every phase number in the report is not durable evidence and the attribution cannot be re-derived.

the production 438 s outlier r-20261007T041913587977 — the slow dispatch this node was dispatched to explain — is attributed to the worktree checkout by inference, not measurement: its mint-to-pointer 264 s span is reconstructed from the mtimes of a fixture attempt killed at 300 s, and the '~26x under contention' figure compares that whole span against the clean run's ~10 s phase total plus one claim-write sample (4.533 s vs 0.079 s); no phase of an actual slow run was ever phase-attributed to completion, so 'attributed to a measured phase' holds for the last clean fixture only.

item_verdicts.diff: no commit exists against the reviewed base 9635d54f (the reviewed worktree head equals its base, git rev-parse HEAD = 9635d54f42bf24355a7a1f4e945e60b665a2d42b and log shows only the promoted parent); every changed_path the manifest lists is under the one declared write path and no product code was touched.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a per-phase seconds table for the slow shape and a small two-path node; the report's tables A and B under 'Measured tables' record them and reconcile with diag-slow.log and diag-small.log (plan_dispatch 4.473 s, _budget_verdict 3.790 s, _raise_repository_scope_conflict 15.569 s x1, _repository_scope_claims 1.220 s x58).
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a slow dispatch have its time attributed to a measured phase; the report (slow-dispatch-phases-report.md) attributes the fixture dispatches to named instrumented phases, but the production outlier is reconstructed rather than phase-measured.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records test_logs phases-small.json/diag-small.log/diag-slow.log, states tests: no suite run and baseline_suite/after_suite 'not run (no product change; single-pass measurement node)', and lists its changed_paths all inside the run directory.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares the single exclusive write path /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261007T042853127894-slow-dispatch-phases; the role is read-only on the repository and every write is a log or the report under it.

justifications.durability: no test exists to guard the deliverable and the measurement instrument is un-deposited in node-local /tmp (report:12), so nothing fails if the report's numbers or citations are edited, and the attribution cannot be re-derived.
justifications.evidence: phases-small.json (exit_code 7) and diag-small.log reconcile with the report's table A, and phases-slow.json (exit_code 1) with table B, so the gate's numbers are recorded on disk rather than claimed; but the harness named at report:12 is retained only in /tmp/sdp, and the headline 'actually slow' case is inferred, so the evidence is real yet not fully reproducible.
justifications.fit: the report and manifest follow the run-dir evidence idiom of sibling measurement nodes, use a phase-table form with units, and introduce no plan, sprint or ticket label into a filename or a symbol.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the report attributes the clean fixture dispatch to measured phases (diag-slow.log: plan_dispatch 4.473 s, _budget_verdict 3.790 s) but the 438 s production outlier is reconstructed from a killed attempt's mtimes (report:75-101), not attributed to a completed phase measurement of a slow run.
justifications.reuse: the run added no definition and forked no capability - it changed no source and has no commits against base 9635d54f; the only artefacts are evidence files under its own run directory.
justifications.scope_discipline: every changed_path is under the one declared write path (the run directory) and no product code was touched; the scratch-root override and the fixture git-shim bypass are disclosed in the manifest's retry_failures rather than hidden.
